TI.P: Information relating to the entry into force of the Agreement between the European Community and Canada on trade in wines and spirit drinks

ENACTING.TERMS.P:
The Agreement between the European Community and Canada on trade in wines and spirit drinks
OJ L 35 of 6.2.2004, p. 3., entered into force on 1 June 2004, the procedures provided for in Article 41 of the Agreement having been completed on 27 April 2004.
